subject: religious-studies

source.track: IGCSE · ages 14–16 · all candidates study Christianity, Islam and Judaism · Paper 1 Worship, Beliefs, Scriptures and Sacred Places · Paper 2 Festivals, Fasts, Family Life and Social Action

note: Units follow the syllabus's two papers: each theme area is taught once and studied across all three set religions, whose topics carry their own content codes (C = Christianity, I = Islam, J = Judaism). The syllabus covers Christianity, Islam and Judaism only; a closing atlas-only unit tracks live lessons on other traditions and on method and philosophy of religion.
